title: Sharjah Publishers Conference 2025
summary: Rights meetings at table 162 with our 2025 catalogues.
body:
The 15th Sharjah Publishers Conference, held on 2–4 November 2025 and organised by the Sharjah Book Authority, brought together publishers and literary agencies from around the world.

[Our look back at the Publishers Conference](/news/looking-ahead-to-the-sharjah-international-publishers-conference/)
image_alt: At the entrance of the Publishers Conference in Sharjah, 2025
seo_description: Epsilon Publishing Group at the Sharjah Publishers Conference, 2–4 November 2025, at Expo Centre Sharjah, with rights meetings at table 162.
